summary.text: Mary Williams Benefield is the Republican candidate for the Georgia State Senate, District 55, where she faces Democratic incumbent Randal Mangham in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She has run for the legislature before, in 2022 and 2024, and her career experience includes accounting, according to Ballotpedia.

paragraphs.text: Williams Benefield was born in Decatur, Georgia, and her career experience includes working in accounting.
In 2022 she was the Republican candidate for Georgia House of Representatives District 81, losing the general election to incumbent Scott Holcomb, 70.0% to 30.0%.

In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey she described herself as a lifelong DeKalb County resident and eighth-generation Georgian, and listed fiscal responsibility with taxpayer funds, accountability of elected officials and election processes that are trackable, auditable and transparent among her priorities.
In 2024 she ran for Senate District 55, losing the general election to Mangham, 76.0% to 24.0%.
